title: Native mobile E2E on iOS Simulator and Android Emulator (Maestro) in CI

acceptance_criteria.outcome: A native test build can only point at a local backend and only when built as the e2e variant: production builds ignore the URL override; an e2e build with a missing or non-local URL, a production profile combined with the e2e variant, or an artifact whose checksum differs from build-evidence.json is refused.

The test backend launcher refuses any database that is not a local disposable trackspense_e2e_* database, explicitly sets every sensitive/outbound setting (AI, LLM fallback, mail, push, JWT) so a local .env cannot leak in, and uses a separate database per run and platform.

On the iOS Simulator, the smoke flows (login and relaunch, expense creation, draft recovery, tab render, group expense) pass against the compiled app, each runnable alone and in any order, with persisted data verified through the API.
On the Android Emulator (run locally), the same smoke flows pass against the compiled app.

Regression flows prove: a lost save response is not blindly resubmitted and leaves exactly one expense; account switch leaks no data or draft; receipt import runs the native OCR path (parse_ocr text lines, no image fallback); deep-link join behaves as specified.

The native E2E runs locally on both platforms (make mobile-e2e-*); the mobile-e2e workflow is kept dormant (manual dispatch only) with Android and iOS jobs, uploaded diagnostics and a final Native mobile gate that passes only for a classified not-applicable change or when both platforms pass, and fails (as a job, not just in its log) on classification failure or any failed, cancelled or unexpectedly skipped platform job.

At release time the native E2E is required only when mobile code changed: make release-prepare adds a native-mobile-e2e check when any mobile-affecting file changed since the previous release tag (or there is no previous tag); the release gate reports it missing until passed is recorded with local regression reports for both platforms on the candidate; with no mobile change it is recorded as not applicable.

Testing standards, verification and definition of done, QA docs, architecture/infrastructure docs, AGENTS files, roadmap, feature status and changelog describe the native E2E layer and its limits (simulator/emulator only); B-19 and JM coverage are marked complete only with CI evidence.

implementation_approval.reference: This conversation, 2026-11-25: "Lets keep both Android and iOS test local only for the relesae phase and only when there is changes to mobile code. Fix those android fix, gate fix but make it local only for now." (amends AC-004, AC-006, AC-007 and required_evidence: native E2E local and release-time only when mobile code changed; CI workflow dormant; Android and gate fixes kept) Interpretation notes by Claude Code: 'required when there is no previous release tag' is a fail-safe reading, not stated by the owner; the kept gate fix is verified by framework-tests (the gate step executed with GitHub's shell rules) instead of the dropped ci-gate-negative CI evidence.

notes: Simulator/emulator automation only; physical-device validation tracked separately. Built on branch mobile-qa-implementation, merged in PR #50 (2026-11-25). STATE 2026-11-25: 13 flows pass locally on iOS; Android 13/13 then 12/13 (A-3). Owner decision 2026-11-25: native E2E is local, release-time evidence, required only when mobile code changed since the previous release (release_tools.py native-mobile-e2e check, always present in RELEASE_CHECKS); the CI workflow is dormant (manual dispatch). Device evidence recorded earlier belongs to older snapshots; the next mobile release supplies fresh local reports.
